messages:
clara (Billing): Murchison Labs INV-2026-1109 (USD 9,750) hit 45 days past due. Customer says AP has two open vendor IDs after M&A and payments bounced. They asked for a 45-day extension and no collections flag while they consolidate.
rick (Collections): For >$5k this needs exec/Revenue Ops approval. Two routes: 1) formal extension with signed waiver that keeps AR aged but notes concession, or 2) short-term accommodation: accept 30% now (wire/virtual card), remainder on net45 with auto-retry. Must include PO and updated vendor ID.
clara (Billing): Gateway log shows ACH_return_r03 on last two attempts. They offered partial wire of $2,925 today if we accept vendor consolidation docs by EOD tomorrow.
dee (Revenue Ops): Material change to payment terms requires Revenue Ops + Finance sign-off. If we record extended terms, revenue may need deferral. We can approve a 45-day extension only if Legal signs the waiver and FP&A accepts the deferral note.
zane (FinOps): Recommend option 2 to reduce credit risk: accept partial wire today, staged remaining on net45, no fee waiver. If we grant full no-collection flag, log the concession in AR with GL 4399 and flag for leadership.
rick (Collections): I'll draft the partial-payment + consolidation agreement with termination clause if docs not provided by EOD tomorrow. Also add a clause to revoke accommodation if we see any new payment failures.
billing-bot: System: invoice INV-2026-1109 status updated to "accommodation_pending" by clara (Billing) at 2165008030.
clara (Billing): OK I'll send the wire instructions and the agreement link. Customer replies: treasury confirms wire for $2,925 will be sent today and will email consolidation docs by tomorrow COB.
dee (Revenue Ops): Conditional approval: Wire must clear and docs delivered. If both happen, Revenue Ops will sign off on the 45-day staged term. Otherwise Collections resumes normal dunning.
zane (FinOps): Noted. Finance will monitor. Please capture the concession note for weekly AR.
clara (Billing): Thanks all. I'll post an audit note and set 48h follow-up. :white_check_mark:
